high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from NASA's "Global Climate Change: Vital Signs of the Planet" website. The content discusses the role of hydroxyl (OH) radicals in the atmosphere and their impact on methane emissions, which are significant contributors to climate change. Header: The top of the page features the NASA logo on the left side. The title "GLOBAL CLIMATE CHANGE" is prominently displayed in white text against a dark blue background. Below the title, the subtitle "Vital Signs of the Planet" is written in a lighter font.
